subject: Quick fit Qs before demo — billing / embeddings throughput
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@nimblepay.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — NimblePay sandbox / integration check

Hi Chloe,

I signed up for Redwood last week and poked around the sandbox. We’re evaluating options for powering a receipts/merchant support flow and want to see how embeddings + generation would work in our pipeline.

High level: we need a hosted API with predictable latency for user-facing requests and batch embeddings for nightly reconciliation. Expected scale is roughly 3–5M tokens/month and ~200k embeddings/month to start, with peak concurrency perhaps 30–60 RPS for user sessions. Timeline: pilot Q3, production by Q4 if things look good.

Can we get a short demo + integration discussion next week? I attached a quick CSV with a sample of our trial traffic.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations | NimblePay Inc.
samir@nimblepay.com
Attachment: trial_usage.csv (CSV)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — NimblePay sandbox / integration check

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and the sample file, looks helpful. I’m Chloe from Redwood’s SDR team; looping in Karthik (infra/serving) so we can address throughput/latency details on the call. A few quick questions so we make the demo actionable for your team: 

- Primary demo goal: see production latency under user traffic, or proof-of-concept integration + SDK experience, or both?
- Typical request size: average and 95th percentile token lengths for generation requests?
- Embeddings: are the 200k/month independent small texts (~150 tokens) or larger batched documents? Any vector store you plan to use?
- Security/compliance: will you need SSO, SCIM, or an on-prem/private deployment evaluation?
- Attendees: who from NimblePay should join (engineering, product, security)?

If you can paste short answers, I’ll tailor the demo and drop a few slot options. If easier, here are three windows we have next week:
- Tue 23 Jun 09:00–09:30 PT
- Wed 24 Jun 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu 25 Jun 14:00–14:45 PT

Also attaching a traffic template that helps us size Dedicated capacity if you go that route.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive (Inbound) | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
Attachment: traffic_matrix_template.xlsx (Excel)

From: Samir Patel <samir@nimblepay.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — NimblePay sandbox / integration check

Hi Chloe — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers below so you can frame the demo: 

- Primary demo goal: both — we want to validate end-to-end latency for user-facing generation (sub-second targets for simple prompts) and see embedding throughput/cost for nightly jobs.
- Request sizes: average generation prompt ~120 tokens, response ~60 tokens; 95th percentile prompt ~600 tokens (rare).
- Embeddings: 200k/month are short customer messages (~50–150 tokens) stored in Pinecone today. We do some batch-updates overnight where latency is not critical.
- Security: must support SSO for product team; data retention controls are important. We do not need on-prem at pilot stage but would like to understand Private options for compliance teams.
- Attendees: Nadia Carson (CTO), 1 backend engineer (me), product manager (TBD).

Any of the slots you suggested work for Nadia and me except Tue morning. Wed 11:00 PT would be ideal. If you can lock that, I’ll send a calendar invite.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations | NimblePay Inc.
Attachment: none

Great — Wed 24 Jun 11:00–11:45 PT is locked. I’ve created a calendar event and included a short pre-demo checklist so we can hit the ground running:

- Confirm attendees (accept invite)
- If possible, drop a small sample of 10 representative texts (redacted) into the shared Drive link below so Karthik can pre-run an embedding perf sample
- Tell us any SSO provider (Okta/Azure) so we can bring SSO notes

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=nimblepay-demo-20260624
Drive (sample drop): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-example

Karthik will demo a short latency profile with a few model variants and then we’ll walk integration patterns (SDK, batching, caching). If anything changes or you need to reschedule, reply to this thread and we’ll move the meeting. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive (Inbound) | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
